Generator 15.75KV
 THDD108/44
 SIEMENS
Introduction

This document lists the equipment inspections I1, I2, I3, I4, which must 
 performed every day, week, month, and 3 months as mentioned by D1, W1, M1, M3 
 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Saleh Abdou, tested by eng 
 Mohamed Abaas & eng Tawfeek Ramadan, revised by EDEPCo.quality control eng. Tawfeek Elabasery, accepted by general manager eng Tarek 
 Youssef 
 Ali, approved by eng Mechaeal George Habashy head sector of Ayoun Moussa 
 power station, and certified by eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPCo. inspection & 
 quality control head sector
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Wear the appropriate safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet,
 earplug .... etc

Take care: the 
 generator in service.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Safety helmet, earplug, and Safety shoes
Exhaust filter and air filter of the fan motor

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Daily

items: Check sight glasses after level detectors for liquid level.
Check gas consumption.

sections.text: Weekly
Check hydrogen cooler vent.
Check shaft-grounding brushes.
Check carbon brushes.
Check seal oil cooler in operation for proper venting.
Check seal oil supply lines and shut off valves for leakage.
Check degree of contamination of seal oil filter.
Check oil level and contamination of oil in vacuum pump.
Drain liquid from drain traps before and after vacuum pump.

sections.text: Monthly

Change over 
 seal oil pump no. 1&2 i.e. Change the selector switch of seal oil pump 
from 1 to 2 and vise versa

Perform 
 functional check of stand by seal oil pump. (Check for abnormal sound, 
vibration, excessive load current ... etc)

Change over 
 vapor exhausters no.1&2.

Check 
 intake strainer in take port of vacuum pump.

Check 
 exhaust filter at vacuum pump.

Re-grease 
 shaft seal of vapor of exhauster.
